project_type: React 18 + TypeScript social media app (Capacitor Android)
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom, @testing-library/react, setup at src/test/setup.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compiles. 2. Run npm run test to run vitest suite.
environment_constraints: Open internet - npm installs work. No Firebase emulator available (use mocks in tests). Firebase env vars not set so no runtime testing against backend.
contribution_requirements: Primary backend: Firebase Firestore. Auth: Firebase Auth. UI: Premium dark theme, mobile-first (440px shell), framer-motion animations. Payments: MANUAL UTR approval (not Razorpay/Stripe). All new Firestore-based code should import from @/lib/firebase.
key_patterns: Pages in src/pages/, components in src/components/<domain>/. Hooks in src/hooks/. Firebase db imported from @/lib/firebase. BuyCoinsSheet already uses Firebase (coin_topups collection). TipSheet still uses Supabase (needs rewrite to Firebase). LiveHost/LiveViewer use Supabase for livekit-token, live_streams, live_chat, live_gifts. Admin OS pages in src/pages/admin-os/. Routes registered in App.tsx. Platform services in src/services/platform/platform.ts. shadcn/ui components, Sheet pattern from bottom, motion animations. Tests use vitest + jsdom + @testing-library/react.
directory_structure: src/pages/ - page components. src/components/<domain>/ - reusable components by domain (wallet/, social/, vibe/, layout/). src/hooks/ - custom hooks. src/lib/ - utilities (firebase.ts, cloudinary.ts, format.ts). src/services/ - service layers. src/contexts/ - React context providers (AuthProvider). src/test/ - test setup. Routes defined in App.tsx with lazy imports.
